name: 習得した内容から復習を選ぶ
prompt: Edit image 1 only as a palette correction. Image 1 is the current candidate; image 2 is the native Japanese content and geometry authority. Preserve image 1's 936×1681 canvas, every position, size, spacing, typography, card and divider geometry, pure-white surfaces, exact Japanese copy, and the circular group photo with its people, crop, scale, and color unchanged. Change only four existing green regions: both completed progress-bar fills and the large 「復習を始める」 primary button fill become the exact owner-approved forest-green gradient, linear-gradient(135deg, #174C36 0%, #1F6444 58%, #2D8F5E 100%), running from lower-left toward upper-right; recolor the lower speaker glyph to neutral slate #526173 without changing its bounds or row surface. Keep the progress tracks neutral gray, the button label white, and the existing green 100% completion text unchanged. Preserve the photo exactly; do not redraw, recolor, retouch, crop, move, or replace it. Preserve exact text: 習得したことを復習; 今回の内容をすべて習得しました。; 次のレッスンで新しい内容に進みましょう。; 自分のコースから; 1つの概念; 習得率：100%; はじめての会話・第1部; 100%; 次のおすすめの復習：364日後; 復習を始める; 聞き取りを復習; 学んだ内容を音声でもう一度. Do not add, remove, move, resize, redraw, or restyle any other element. No new UI, tint, shadow or texture.
reviewNotes: Opened the saved 936x1681 candidate and compared it with v001 and the native preview. Both progress fills and the review action visibly show the three-stop green direction; the speaker utility glyph is slate. The group photo, crop, card sections, white surfaces, Japanese text and order appear retained. This raster does not prove exact native gradient values or app implementation; owner approval remains pending. Manifest only; no combined catalog, local site, or public publication was refreshed.
